entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I bought some shoes, and I think I need to return them? I'm a bit confused about the process.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Smith, order number VF789012. I'm just so overwhelmed by the website. I couldn't figure it out.

No problem at all, Alex. I've pulled up your order for the Road Cycling Shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, a preference, I guess? They just don't feel right. The one time I wore them I got terrible blisters on my heel. And I couldn't get the cleats to work at all. It was all very complicated. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I'm sorry to hear the cycling shoes weren't a good fit and caused blisters. Let me just check the purchase date here... I see the order was delivered about 30 days ago.
Is that bad? I wasn't sure what the rule was. I got so confused trying to read the policy page.
Not at all. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So you can do it?

Yes, I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file as we speak. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. You should see it in 3-5 business days after that.
Wow, that was so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Diana! You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
